# Stage 5 silicon tables (generated by sw/x310/nsclf_analyze.py; do not edit)

Labels: **silicon** = decisions of the X310 (proven by MISR equality with the block read-back) against labels from the TX schedule; D, SNR and noise figures are silicon measurements of the captures; **model** figures are from evidence/stage5/accuracy_meas.md (v2: measured-channel model, exported = RTL, test set, 100,000 windows). "settled" = windows starting >= 2 x 2^20 samples (10.5 ms) after the burst arrives, when the DC step at the TX burst start has decayed to e^-2 by the rx_dcoffset IIR (README section 4); with a TX lead-in >= 10.5 ms every window is settled.
